relations.subject: Michael Viggo Fausböll
relations.evidence: He became a student at the University of Copenhagen in 1838 and received his  Cand.theol. in 1847.

relations.subject: Michael Viggo Fausböll
relations.evidence: From 1878 to 1902 Fausbøll was professor   at the University of Copenhagen where he taught Sanskrit and East Indian philology.

relations.subject: Max Müller
relations.evidence: His Latin translation of the Dhammapada was published in 1855 with a new edition in 1900. It formed the basis for the first complete translation of this text into English, by philologist Max Müller

relations.subject: Michael Viggo Fausböll
relations.evidence: It was published in six volumes, with an additional seventh volume containing the various kinds of indexes to the volumes compiled by Dines Andersen.
